name: theme-paper
title: Paper theme
description: A quiet printed look for editorial and broadcast furniture: near-white surfaces, square corners, hairline rules, an IBM Plex Sans and Instrument Serif pairing, and a press that squeezes and shifts colour instead of dropping 6px. Install it, then set data-gs-theme="paper" on the root.
docs: Import gamestage-theme-paper.css after gamestage-tokens.css, and set data-gs-theme="paper" on <html> or on any subtree. Paper is the theme that shows the layer is more than a palette: it differs from base and from arcade on typeface, press gesture, edge treatment and radius, so a greyscale screenshot of the three still shows three products. Its press gesture is scale(0.97) with a colour shift; under prefers-reduced-motion the build replaces the gesture with none and the colour shift carries the whole response.
